nodes.name: _capture_study_cells
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's study cells for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_schedule_timelines
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's schedule timelines for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_instances
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's scheduled activity instances for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_decision_instances
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's decision instances for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_bc_surrogates
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's biomedical concept surrogates for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_biomedical_concepts
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's biomedical concepts for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_bc_properties
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's biomedical concept properties for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_amendments
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's study amendments for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _capture_extension_attributes
nodes.summary: Captures a point-in-time snapshot of a SoA's extension attributes for inclusion in a freeze record.

nodes.name: _diff_entity_list
nodes.summary: Generic list-diff utility comparing two lists of entity dicts by UID key, classifying each as added, removed, or changed (with per-field before/after values) for the given display fields.

nodes.name: _list_freezes
nodes.summary: Fetches all freeze records for a SoA, ordered by creation time, for listing in the UI.

nodes.name: _get_freeze
nodes.summary: Fetches a single freeze record and its stored snapshot payload for a SoA.

nodes.name: _create_freeze
nodes.summary: Creates a new freeze by capturing snapshots of every trackable entity type (arms, timings, objectives, endpoints, encounters, cells, timelines, instances, decision instances, BCs, surrogates, amendments, extension attributes) and storing them as a single freeze record.

nodes.name: _diff_freezes_limited
nodes.summary: Computes the full structural diff between two freezes (or a freeze and the live study) across every entity type, using `_diff_entity_list`, optionally capping the number of changed entities returned per section.

nodes.name: _rollback_freeze
nodes.summary: Restores the live study's entities to match a prior freeze's captured snapshot, deleting/recreating rows as needed and recording a rollback audit entry.

nodes.name: _record_rollback_audit
nodes.summary: Records an audit trail entry summarizing the statistics of a freeze rollback operation (entities restored, added, removed).

nodes.name: _list_rollback_audit
nodes.summary: Fetches the rollback audit history for a SoA.

nodes.name: _delete_freeze
nodes.summary: Deletes a freeze record and its stored snapshot data.

nodes.name: _rollback_preview
nodes.summary: Computes a preview of what a rollback to a given freeze would change, without applying it, by diffing the freeze snapshot against live data.

nodes.name: amendments.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router implementing CRUD for protocol amendments and their sub-entities (secondary reasons, impacts, changes with document-content-reference sections, geographic scopes, subject enrollments, governance dates), each tied to a freeze.

nodes.name: _next_uid
nodes.summary: Generic monotonic UID generator that finds the max numeric suffix for a given prefix/table/column combination and returns the next value; the shared implementation behind all `_next_*_uid` helpers in this file.

nodes.name: _next_amendment_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next StudyAmendment UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_reason_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next StudyAmendmentReason UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_impact_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next StudyAmendmentImpact UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_change_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next StudyChange UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_ref_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next DocumentContentReference UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_scope_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next GeographicScope UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_enrollment_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next SubjectEnrollment UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _next_gov_date_uid
nodes.summary: Generates the next GovernanceDate UID for a SoA.

nodes.name: _insert_code
nodes.summary: Inserts a Code row recording a controlled-terminology value used by an amendment sub-entity (e.g. reason type, impact type).

nodes.name: _update_code_value
nodes.summary: Updates an existing Code row's value and codelist reference in place.

nodes.name: _geo_scope_category
nodes.summary: Maps a geographic scope type code to its category grouping (e.g. country vs. region) used for location lookups.

nodes.name: _get_countries
nodes.summary: Fetches available country controlled-terminology rows for geographic scope selection.

nodes.name: _get_regions
nodes.summary: Fetches available geographic region controlled-terminology rows for geographic scope selection.

nodes.name: _insert_location_code
nodes.summary: Inserts the appropriate country or region Code row for a geographic scope location value, based on its category.

nodes.name: _amendment_row
nodes.summary: Fetches a single StudyAmendment row for a SoA/amendment ID pair.

nodes.name: _load_amendment_data
nodes.summary: Loads a StudyAmendment along with all of its related sub-entities (reasons, impacts, changes, geographic scopes, enrollments, governance dates) into a single context dict for rendering.

nodes.name: _load_amendment_context
nodes.summary: Builds the full template context (amendment data plus dropdown option lists) used by the amendment edit page.

nodes.name: create_amendment
nodes.summary: API endpoint creating a new StudyAmendment record tied to a freeze, including its primary reason code.

nodes.name: get_amendment
nodes.summary: API endpoint returning a StudyAmendment's full data (with sub-entities) as JSON.

nodes.name: update_amendment
nodes.summary: API endpoint updating a StudyAmendment's editable fields.

nodes.name: delete_amendment
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a StudyAmendment and cascading deletes across all of its sub-entities (reasons, impacts, changes, scopes, enrollments, governance dates).

nodes.name: add_secondary_reason
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a secondary reason record to an amendment.

nodes.name: add_impact
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a impact record to an amendment.

nodes.name: add_change
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a change record to an amendment.

nodes.name: add_geographic_scope
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a geographic scope record to an amendment.

nodes.name: add_enrollment
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a subject enrollment record to an amendment.

nodes.name: add_governance_date
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a governance date record to an amendment.

nodes.name: delete_secondary_reason
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a secondary reason from an amendment.

nodes.name: delete_impact
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting an impact record from an amendment.

nodes.name: delete_change
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a change record from an amendment, cascading to its document-content-reference sections.

nodes.name: add_section
nodes.summary: API endpoint adding a DocumentContentReference protocol section link to a StudyChange.

nodes.name: delete_section
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a DocumentContentReference section from a StudyChange.

nodes.name: delete_geographic_scope
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a geographic scope from an amendment.

nodes.name: delete_enrollment
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a subject enrollment record from an amendment.

nodes.name: delete_governance_date
nodes.summary: API endpoint deleting a governance date from an amendment, unlinking its geographic scope associations.

nodes.name: ui_amendment_edit
nodes.summary: Renders the full amendment edit page for a freeze, including all sub-entity sections.

nodes.name: ui_amendment_form_fields
nodes.summary: Renders the dropdown option fields (reason codes, type codes) needed by the amendment creation form.

nodes.name: ui_create_amendment
nodes.summary: UI form endpoint creating a new StudyAmendment with its primary reason, returning the refreshed amendment edit page.

nodes.name: _ui_reasons_partial
nodes.summary: Renders the secondary-reasons HTML partial for an amendment, used for HTMX swaps.
